headline: Gameweek 12 is near, and this channel's creator is pushing a weekly routine: pick a team, then keep it simple.

points.text: Many videos in this material are about Gameweek 12 team picks, transfers and captains. Several focus on Raya's status and goalkeeper buys.
points.label: reported

points.text: Raya is in the news. One video says he is injured, and another calls it a Raya update. The material does not confirm his fitness.
points.label: reported

points.text: One creator says it is time to buy a goalkeeper and shares a team for Gameweek 12.
points.label: opinion

points.text: One creator asks whether Wirtz is essential and says Haaland is not the captain choice this week.
points.label: opinion

points.text: A 15-minute weekly window could work well here. Pick your team once, check Raya's news, then make one safe move.
points.label: ai interpretation

differences.text: One creator says Haaland is not the captain pick. Another frames the week around buying a goalkeeper. Both are personal views, not facts.
